text_block_list.text:
The Grand Live—a festival once organized 
voluntarily by the students once a year, 
where every single Umamusume took the 
stage.

However, that is strictly a thing of the 
past. Light Hello insisted on bringing it 
back, but the URA kept turning her down, 
claiming that nobody wanted it.

She wants to give everyone a live concert 
as a place to express their gratitude... 
Sympathizing with that sentiment, Smart 
Falcon offers her support.

To revive the Grand Live, let's make the 
announcement live a hit and gather 
supporters! The Grand Live revival project 
is officially underway!
